turns.text: What does HIS mean for an ABDM integration?

must_contain: the catalogue calls this HMIS, not HIS
HMIS is NHA's term for the software a hospital runs day to day
an HMIS acts as a HIP when it publishes a record and as an HIU when it fetches one
notes: reader spelled it HIS; catalogue atom shared.glossary.hmis spells it HMIS.
